subject: Grocers file antitrust suit to block Mamdani admin’s plan for NYC-owned supermarkets: ‘Predatory pricing’
posts:
New York grocers file a federal antitrust lawsuit to halt Mayor Mamdani's subsidized municipal supermarket initiative.
Evidence: Subsidized 30% discount, Antitrust lawsuit, Threat to local shops
#Aletheia #NYC #Business

Supporters claim the municipal grocery initiative will provide vital affordable food access across all five boroughs, easing living costs for struggling residents.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.5) — Good Preference

The program deploys taxpayer-backed subsidies, free rent, and tax exemptions to run permanent 30% discounts that threaten to displace independent minority- and immigrant-owned grocery stores.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.85, -0.8) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Municipal interventions masked as affordability schemes function as state-backed predatory pricing, crushing independent small businesses.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 11.2, z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Mamdani Administration: FAIL (-0.8, -0.7) — Subsidized disruption.
- National Supermarket Association: PASS (+0.7, +0.5) — Protecting market fairness.
Independent grocers filed a federal antitrust lawsuit under the Clayton Act, attempting to block NYC's plan to open city-run supermarkets offering a 30% discount on staples.

The Bright Side:
Brought vital attention to the economic unfairness of municipal enterprises competing directly against heavily taxed private neighborhood bodegas.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing the structural policy goal (WHAT: food affordability) with the human and economic cost (WHO: destroying independent immigrant grocers).

Social Physics Analysis:
The administration runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver by using public subsidies to manufacture a populist victory while displacing local merchants, projecting fault onto private competition.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil through state-backed market distortion.

The Unavoidable Truth: Municipal tax subsidies give city-run stores an unfair advantage that can crush independent grocers.

The Unavoidable Lie: Claiming this state-run program is a neutral fix rather than a predatory squeeze on local enterprise.

Alethekanon:
State-subsidized retail undercuts the very community small businesses that sustained neighborhoods through decades of economic neglect.

Awwthekanon:
It hurts to see family-owned bodegas that weathered decades of neighborhood struggle now squeezed out by government-backed corporate-style competition.

Brothekanon:
Can't have the city opening discount supermarkets that don't pay rent and then act shocked when local bodega owners sue for unfair competition.

Spirithekanon:
"Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right." Proverbs 16:8 PASS
Righteous ends do not justify unjust means that dismantle the livelihoods of honest workers.
